name: Banshee
gmNotes: A Banshee is a medical researcher/scanner role — not a biological species. A typical Banshee is Fey and also carries the Medical Researcher profession Archetype. Banshee medical filters resemble hair. Their comb-like sonic scanners operate above ordinary Fey hearing but produce a shrill wail to humans. Cloth-like analytic membranes test water for contamination and can darken or turn red, inspiring the bloody-cloth omen. Do not reveal these functions in player-facing description until the fiction earns them; consult the searchable Fey technology and biology dossiers for detail.
description: A voice on the wind that some say foretells death — a wail heard in the hills before the news arrives. In the village, hearing a banshee is an omen, and no two people agree on what it means.
